description: This file defines several simple-methods related to Bill of Materials (BOM) operations within an manufacturing context, including creating, copying, updating, and deleting BOM associations and manufacturing rules.

methods.name: createBOMAssoc
methods.description: Creates an association between products in BOM, with duplicate detection.

methods.name: copyBOMAssocs
methods.description: Copies BOM associations from one product to another.

methods.name: eventEditBOM
methods.description: Handles editing operations on BOM components, including creating, updating, deleting, and copying.

methods.name: updateProductManufacturingRule
methods.description: Updates an existing manufacturing rule for a product.

methods.name: addProductManufacturingRule
methods.description: Creates a new manufacturing rule for a product.

methods.name: deleteProductManufacturingRule
methods.description: Removes a manufacturing rule associated with a product.
